snippet.title: [Anime Girl dresses to work to take care of a goat in this Horror] Dressed For Work (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
=Game link :https://karelessocelot.itch.io/dressed-for-work
=Commentary Version: https://youtu.be/JAFSM9brjPI

Timestamping:
0:00 - intro content warning
0:05 - intro of nothing... enjoy the title screen
0:52 - game start/gameplay
23:55 - game end/enjoy the title screen to outro/endscreen

Well, here we are with another game by a friend of mine, karelessocelot, Dressed For Work, which is a short dress-up minigame vn, about getting dressed up for work and taking care a goat.

Overall, this is a good vn game. I do enjoy the dress-up part of this game. I like the custom cursors it has as well. Art of theirs as always is nice, and the character designs. Tho I remember them saying, they’re not proud of this one, and I can see the reasons, but still, it’s not bad, I’m not gonna lie on that.

Still, it felt like played LobCorp indirectly, without playing the game yet.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy, and may stars guide you!
